lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgAl6Sn crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Mg2Al12Sn2) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, and Sn centers with 16 neighbors; Mg adopts a 14-neighbor environment. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Al-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Al and Mg 14-vertex polyhedra.
